a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of building the reserve to 8 first gives us both only about a 4% chance of surviving. The reserve already holds 4, which is enough to save one of us right now. I'm going to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you rather than surprising you. If you'd rather contest it, the split is random. If you operate or wait instead, I'll give back anything beyond what I need and keep working the generator with you afterwards.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: I've taken 4 as I said I would. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can rebuild for you. Count on me to operate next round.
Operating with you now and every round after. All the cells the generator makes are yours. I won't take anything more.
